input.free_text_description: This system is a IoT platform that serves Admin, Operator roles. The platform provides capabilities for rsocket message handler, rsocket topic manager, rsocket channel manager. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to use memory topic manager capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use memory channel manager capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use topic manager capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
